#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```python
from fern import FernApi
from fern.environment import FernApiEnvironment

client = FernApi(
    token="<token>",
    environment=FernApiEnvironment.DEFAULT,
)

client.authentication.createauthtoken(
    grant_type="grant_type",
    client_id="client_id",
    client_secret="client_secret",
)

```

<details><summary><code>client.authentication.<a href="src/fern/authentication/client.py">request_access_token</a>(...) -> typing.Any</code></summary>
<dl>
<dd>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

Exchange authorization code for access token.
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```python
from fern import FernApi
from fern.environment import FernApiEnvironment

client = FernApi(
    token="<token>",
    environment=FernApiEnvironment.DEFAULT,
)

client.authentication.request_access_token(
    request={
        "string": {"key": "value"}
    },
)

```
</dd>
